diff --git a/python/sglang/srt/layers/dp_attention.py b/python/sglang/srt/layers/dp_attention.py
index 5fa7ce0..9bbfc81 100644
--- a/python/sglang/srt/layers/dp_attention.py
+++ b/python/sglang/srt/layers/dp_attention.py
@@ -280,7 +280,15 @@ def dp_scatter(
     # since local_tokens may be padded for cuda graph
     local_start_pos, local_num_tokens = get_dp_local_info(forward_batch)
 
-    local_tokens.fill_(0)
+    # Only zero out the padding portion to avoid unnecessary work
+    # when there are many padding tokens
+    if local_tokens.shape[0] > local_num_tokens:
+        # Buffer has padding: only zero out the padding portion
+        local_tokens[local_num_tokens:].fill_(0)
+    else:
+        # Buffer has no padding or is exactly the right size: zero out entire buffer
+        local_tokens.fill_(0)
+    
     assert local_tokens.is_contiguous()
     assert global_tokens.is_contiguous()
     if local_tokens.shape[0] > 0:
